entries.clue: Drift into light sleep in the armchair with the paper still on your lap
Round tub of a boat, goatskin stretched over a frame, built by the castaway
Snow-white marsh bird with black legs and startling yellow feet
Deep untroubled sleep, of the kind a cursed princess had for a century
Blunt, dutiful skipper of the Hispaniola, wary of the hands he was given
Dump a man on an empty islet and sail off; also a deep brownish red
Stage of sleep, known by its initials, when dreams are liveliest
Scythe-winged screamer round the May rooftops, gone again come August
Long John's surname, borne by the honey-tongued villain of the tale
Stay in bed far too long and turn up late for work
Female swan, hissing beside her cygnets while the cob patrols
Grey statue in the shallows that waits, stabs, and swallows the fish whole
